proposition.claim:
If ||rho-rho_M||_2<=2M on [0,T], M>=max(1,sqrt(rho_M)), then ||rho-rho_M||_infinity<=C M^2 with universal C, including t=0.

Under the stated Fourier normalization, the gradient norm squared is asserted equal to the unweighted sum of |k|^2 |fhat_N(k)|^2.
